q: In the letter of Jude, whose brother is Jude?
why: He calls himself a servant of Jesus.
quote: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James

q: In Jude, what does Jude urge believers to contend for?
why: It was entrusted once for all.
quote: urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.

q: In Jude's closing praise, God is able to keep you from what?
why: He presents you with great joy.
quote: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling

q: In Jude, which archangel disputed with the devil over Moses' body?
quote: But even the archangel Michael, when he disputed with the devil over the body of Moses
